author: runtime_evidence
classification: New opt-in mechanism acceptance, not historical missing-API behavior regressions
acceptance: Actual native launcher pins publication contract before Popen and preserves the binding when RUNNING is published.
Actual check_active -> training_completion registers declared records and artifact_ids with the terminal transaction.
Independent inode and readback SHA remain stable after a worker writes through its old source descriptor.
Missing, oversized, redirected, or changing sources cannot create accepted records or a successful terminal.
Changed, disabled, newly enabled, or legacy-import-unbound contracts cannot redirect or manufacture producer provenance.
Partial writes leave unaccepted staging and preserve source; a second poll does not repeat large copy IO.
A rejected terminal UPDATE rolls back registered artifact rows and retains the existing effect HOLD.
Default-off, explicitly zero-artifact success, and failed opt-in attempts remain distinct.

implementation_choices.occurrence_id: SHA256 of canonical complete producer AttemptRef, logical_name and results scope; neither content hash nor specification hash
implementation_choices.partial_staging: Create-only deterministic occurrence directories; existing staging refuses blind reuse and requires explicit resolution. No automatic GC or crash recovery is implemented.
implementation_choices.io_boundary: Copy, content hash, fsync and readback hash occur before effect lease / BEGIN IMMEDIATE; terminal writer uses cheap captured identity and metadata checks.
implementation_choices.transaction_boundary: Effect plan then full declared batch registration then lifecycle/compute and native terminal in one SQLite transaction, with final artifact row readback; filesystem and SQLite are not atomic.

real: Snapshot file IO and actual old worker file descriptor
Shared artifact store and contract validators
mocked: Popen child/process identity and stop boundaries from test_native_training_caller_boundaries
GPU fleet ownership query and test-scoped lease boundary from conftest
not_claimed: Paid provider calls or GPU training
Scientific observations or qualified research improvement
Automatic staging recovery or garbage collection
Protection against hostile same-UID filesystem or direct SQL mutation
Final full-suite, source inventory, commit or remote push verification

limitations: Default legacy outputs and existing evaluation paths are unchanged.
Historical artifact lookup is metadata only; it does not grant current attempt ownership or prove confirmed completion.
Read-only snapshot mode is cooperative, not a security sandbox.
Prepared files can remain without accepted records after failure; later ticks refuse that occurrence instead of multiplying large orphan copies.
root_followup: Independent review, final frozen-source full regression, evidence aggregation and commit/push remain owned by root.
